thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Is Up Sharply After Q2 Profit Exceeds Expectations

title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Is Up Sharply After Q2 Profit Exceeds Expectations
text:
Apple Inc. (AAPL) Is Up Sharply After Q2 Profit Exceeds Expectations 5/2/2018 10:05 AM ET
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) reported second quarter EPS of $2.73 after the bell Tuesday, compared to $2.10 last year. The consensus estimate was for EPS of $2.69.
The company also raised its dividend by 16 percent and approved a new $100 billion share buyback plan.
Apple gapped open sharply higher Wednesday morning and is now up 7.29 at $176.39. The stock has jumped to a 2-week high.
